description: Modelled flow stress in Victorian unregulated rivers under current and climate change scenarios is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. The hydrological database is composed of baseline (post-1975 conditions), “current” (represented by post-1997 conditions) and multiple climate change scenarios for a large set of unregulated rivers in Victoria. This is supplied together with pre-compiled information on resulting flow stress, mapped at state scale and for each CMA region individually. Coverage: Victoria. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. Its tags are Environment, Inland waters. It offers 7 resource(s) in dwg, dxf, extended tab, gdb, mif. The portal shows 2026-07-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
